brief: docs/content-amirnet-items-brief.md (marked blocked as of 28/08 — stale: the gate it names, lib/core/amirnetItemGate.ts, exists and is exercised below)
quota_rule: K-006 had zero items in the repo before this tick — measure-amirnet-gate.mjs's own header says 0 files is the expected state until CONTENT starts writing. No quota is set anywhere (41 § 9.4 is open, Roy's to decide). This tick wrote 2 sc + 2 rs per level (1-4) and 2 rc chapters (level 1 and level 3, 5 questions each) as a declared precedent for a first delivery, not a citation of any rule: 16 sc/rs items + 10 rc questions = 26 items. Levels 2 and 4 of rc (reading comprehension) are not yet covered and are the natural next slice.
self_rejected_reason: 5 items initially drafted with words above their level's vocabulary tier or with a correct-answer/distractor length ratio over 1.4 (puppy·ashamed·cheerful at level 1; cancel at level 1; baker at level 1) were rewritten before the final gate run below, not hand-patched after rejection. See lesson entry.
gate_run: npm run measure:amirnet-gate over the three output files above, using the real amirnetItemGate/amirnetChapterGate imported from lib/core/ (not a reimplementation) and the tier map built from data/generated/amirnet-vocab.csv exactly as scripts/measure-amirnet-gate.mjs builds it.
negative_control: 9 deliberately broken sc items (wrong option count · bad correct_index · duplicate options · missing distractor reason · bad level · missing level_rationale · bad source · 'all of the above' · vocabulary above the item's tier) were gated in the same session and 0/9 passed — evidence the gate discriminates and did not pass everything.
human_eye_axes: ⛔ originality — no item, passage, or distractor is copied, rewritten, or 'varied' from plan/41-amirnet-spec.md § 6.3 (calibration-only) or from any Amirnet/AMIR'AM/psychometric/commercial-prep source. Every stem, passage, and option was written fresh for this tick. This is a declaration, not something the gate checks — § 6 of the brief says so explicitly.

⛔ sensitive subject in the rc passages — the level-1 passage is a baker's daily routine, the level-3 passage is about coral bleaching; neither touches a sensitive subject, read by the agent, no gate exists for this axis
each rc correct answer was checked by hand against the exact sentence in its passage; each rc question was checked to require reading the passage (none answerable from general knowledge alone)

the sc-l4 and rs-l4 items were checked by hand for the level-4 structural requirements in § 6.2 (two mutually dependent blanks for sc; a long qualifier/double-negation sentence for rs) since these are not machine-checked
vocab_ceiling_note: vocab_band assigned per item level (1000/2000/3000/3000) as a declared precedent — § 5 of the brief only defines bands for tiers 1-3; level-4 items are unconstrained by the gate (no tier exceeds 4) and were mapped to 3000 for lack of a defined higher band.
